listings.thesis: Watchlist: useful ecosystem node, but evidence of under-discovery or upside-to-valuation is mixed.

priorCase.rankRationale: Sanan Optoelectronics should move down because wafers, masks, substrates, photoresists and high-purity materials consumed by AI fabs is either less hidden after 14.4% YTD, less direct to CPO/HBM/package/test bottlenecks, or more exposed to cycle/valuation risk than the current rank 46 implies.
